summary: The implementation correctly replaces the VoiceOver-specific `executionStatusAnnouncer` singleton with `role="status"` on `StatusBadge`. The ARIA approach is sound for NVDA/JAWS: live region fires only on text-content change (not initial mount), `aria-label={undefined}` safely omits the attribute. One non-blocking finding is noted: a pre-existing `aria-hidden="true"` ancestor in `ThoughtHeader` suppresses the new live region there (thought-status transitions remain unannounced).

findings.description: `StatusBadge` is rendered inside `<div aria-hidden="true">` in `ThoughtStatus`. Per the ARIA spec, `aria-hidden` hides the entire subtree, including any `role="status"` live region inside it. This means thought-status transitions will NOT be announced to NVDA/JAWS via the new live region. The badge appears intentionally decorative in this context, but when `isEmbedded` is true the `StatusIndicator` is also hidden and the only status indicator becomes the suppressed badge.
findings.suggestion: If thought status must be announced when `isEmbedded` is true, remove `aria-hidden="true"` from the wrapping div for the `StatusBadge` case, or expose an `aria-live` region outside the hidden subtree. This is out of scope for this ticket and should be tracked as a follow-up accessibility issue.
